title: The Last Hand
overview: A broke and desperate father, Rafael, gambles the rest of his savings in order to secure the future of his daughter Sienna. Struggling to make ends meet after his wife's passing, Rafael sits at a high-stakes poker table, gambling the last of his savings and the keys of his cherished restaurant, his late wife's legacy, in a final bid to pay for Sienna's education. Unknowingly to Rafael, Sienna secretly watches the game unfold as she doubts if she should stop him from betting their past to secure her future.
